**Resolving the effective value with config overrides:** `Settings::half_life` in `src/memory/mod.rs` (line 221–223). It looks up the pre-built `self.half_life` map (which was populated in `Settings::from_config` at lines 192–203 by iterating all kinds and preferring any value from `[memory].half_life` in `leviathan.toml`, falling back to `Kind::default_half_life()`). The scoring code in `src/memory/recall.rs` (line 335) calls `self.settings.half_life(c.m.kind)` to get the effective value at recall time.
